item.title: Kevin Warsh's First Major Speech as Fed Chair Carries High Expectations
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is set to speak at the Jackson Hole economic symposium, with markets watching closely.

item.title: Trump Orders Federal Government to Rename Lake Ontario to Lake America
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario, escalating tensions with Canada.

item.title: Meta agrees to $17B settlement; nuclear regulator to drop radiation safety rule
item.description: Meta and the states that sued it have reached a $17 billion settlement. Meanwhile, nuclear regulators plan to abandon a decades-old radiation safety rule.

item.title: Ratko Mladic, Bosnian Serb commander behind wartime atrocities, dies at 84
item.description: Ratko Mladic, one of the most infamous figures of the 1990s war that killed over 100,000, has died. He ordered troops to 'scorch the brains' of enemies.
